name: Customer Review Topic Classification
model: TF-IDF + Multinomial Naive Bayes / SGD Topic Classifier
description: Automated text topic categorization sorting incoming customer feedback into Product Quality, Shipping, Pricing, Customer Service, and Usability.
limitations: Multi-topic reviews with conflicting sub-themes may be assigned only to the primary dominant keyword class.
responsible_use_notes: Enables triage of operational pain points across cross-functional product departments.
